purpose: Map public integration surfaces and authorization boundaries for a GSPC evidence adapter. This is not a partner, customer, steering-committee, endorsement, or production-integration claim.

shared_contract.effects: Read-only by default. Any write, containment, policy change, payment, deployment, or external submission requires a separately authorized capability and a distinct receipt.
shared_contract.trust_boundary: A public API, MCP server, SDK, listing, or alliance relationship does not grant access to tenant data or imply vendor review or endorsement.

public_surfaces.name: Falcon MCP Server
public_surfaces.auth: Tenant-created Falcon API client ID and secret; module scopes
authorized_actions: connect to a tenant only after that tenant provisions credentials and scopes

organizations.candidate_adapter: Falcon MCP read-only tool allowlist -> evidence envelopes -> GSPC intake
organizations.status: DOCUMENTED_SURFACE; NO TENANT CONNECTION OR LIVE ADAPTER TEST
safety_notes: Request only read scopes for the first integration
Keep credentials in a secret store; never in evidence artifacts
Keep write and response actions disabled

public_surfaces.name: Red Hat Enterprise Contract / Open Policy Agent
public_surfaces.auth: Local OPA/Rego fixture evaluation is possible; organization policy and build records require owner-authorized access
permissionless_actions: evaluate public or locally supplied policy fixtures
authorized_actions: read organization policy or telemetry only with owner-provided access

organizations.candidate_adapter: OPA decision logs and policy fixtures -> normalized control/evidence record
organizations.status: OPEN PROJECT SURFACE; GSPC ADAPTER NOT IMPLEMENTED OR TESTED
safety_notes: A policy decision is evidence of that evaluation only
Do not describe OPA output as Red Hat review or certification

public_surfaces.name: OpenShell
public_surfaces.auth: Local package use; gateway and workload configuration are operator-controlled
authorized_actions: install or enforce policy on a specific runtime only with its operator's approval

organizations.candidate_adapter: OpenShell policy/tool allowlist and runtime observations -> evidence envelopes
organizations.status: LOCAL CANDIDATE; TOOL POLICY PROBED; CURRENT GATEWAY ENFORCEMENT NOT PROVEN
safety_notes: Require positive read test, paid/write denial, and default-deny egress tests
Do not infer NVIDIA endorsement or production deployment

public_surfaces.name: Foundry Ontology MCP
public_surfaces.auth: Foundry Developer Console OAuth; token scope and data permissions are tenant-controlled
authorized_actions: connect only after a customer administrator enables the MCP and grants scoped OAuth

organizations.candidate_adapter: Ontology MCP read-only resource/tool adapter -> evidence envelopes
organizations.status: DOCUMENTED_SURFACE; NO CUSTOMER TENANT OR OAUTH CONNECTION
safety_notes: Default to read-only and least privilege
Do not expose customer ontology data in public indexes

public_surfaces.name: AGNTCY Agent Directory Service
public_surfaces.auth: Public docs and discovery; publishing or federation follows directory rules and requires an explicit publish action
permissionless_actions: inspect directory and public agent cards
authorized_actions: publish, claim, or federate a CSOAI listing only through the directory's current supported route

organizations.candidate_adapter: Agent-card discovery -> endpoint health observation -> GSPC evidence reference
organizations.status: PUBLIC DISCOVERY SURFACE; CSOAI LISTING AND HEALTH CHECK NOT VERIFIED
safety_notes: Directory presence is discovery, not trust or performance evidence
Verify ownership and endpoint health independently

alliance_boundary.verified_public_relationship: Linux Foundation materials identify CrowdStrike, Red Hat, NVIDIA, Palantir, and Cisco among Open Secure AI Alliance inaugural partners; the SAFE RFC announcement identifies initial proposal contributors including Cisco, CrowdStrike, NVIDIA, and Red Hat.
not_established: that all five are steering-committee members

release_gates: negative tests prove writes and out-of-scope reads are denied
tenant owner authorization recorded where required
public documentation distinguishes local test, tenant test, upstream acceptance, and deployment
published artifacts read back anonymously and match exact digests
